ratings.reviewer_notes: Directly tests quercetin effects on intestinal chloride transport and reports activation of CFTR-mediated currents in mouse ileum and colon, but does not study cystic fibrosis intestinal epithelium or demonstrate CFTR expression upregulation.
Tests quercetin against CFTR-mediated transport in human colonic T84 epithelia, but finds inhibition rather than upregulation and does not use cystic fibrosis intestinal epithelium.

Shows quercetin-associated increases in chloride transport in cystic fibrosis and non-cystic fibrosis sinonasal epithelial models, providing adjacent CFTR evidence, but the tissue is airway rather than intestinal epithelium and expression upregulation is not shown.
